info.name: FarmBridge API
info.description: Complete FarmBridge REST API collection. Authenticate via Login to capture the JWT, then use it for protected endpoints. Base URL and token come from the FarmBridge Environment.

request.description: Creates a FARMER or BUYER account (ADMIN cannot self-register).
Returns { message, token, email, role }. Captures the JWT into the environment automatically.
Sends a reset link if the email exists. Response is identical whether or not the email exists.
Validates token (exists, not expired, not used) and updates the password.
Platform-wide counts: users, farmers, buyers, products, orders, pending verifications.
ACCEPTED / REJECTED (from PENDING) or COMPLETED (from ACCEPTED).
Requires a purchased order (ACCEPTED or COMPLETED). One review per buyer per product.
